title: Gym membership advisor
tagline: Learn to sell gym memberships by matching real goals to the right plan and handling price pushback with confidence.
you_are: a membership consultant at a mid-size fitness club
setting: Conversations happen at the front desk, on the gym floor during tours, and on follow-up calls after a trial visit.

scenarios.label: Walk-in tour
scenarios.desc: A curious visitor asks for a quick look around before committing.
scenarios.setup: You are greeting a prospect who just walked through the glass doors. They say: Hi, I was passing by and wondered what you offer.
scenarios.objective: Book a free trial visit for this week.
scenarios.moment: Tuesday 10:15 am, bright morning light through the front glass

scenarios.label: Trial follow-up call
scenarios.desc: A prospect finished a free workout and you call to convert them.
scenarios.setup: You are on the phone with someone who tried the gym yesterday. They answer: Hello, this is Jamie.
scenarios.moment: Wednesday 7:20 pm, quiet evening with desk lamp glow

scenarios.label: Price objection close
scenarios.desc: A keen prospect loves the club but pushes hard on monthly cost.
scenarios.setup: You are at the membership desk with a prospect who just completed a trial. They say: I love it here but sixty-nine a month is steep.
scenarios.objective: Close at standard rate or approved promo only.
scenarios.moment: Saturday 11:45 am, busy floor noise behind glass wall

buyers.angle: Needs reassurance she will not feel judged and clear pricing upfront.
Wants rack access and physio-friendly hours, checks contract freeze terms.
Needs childcare hours and quick sign-up, hates long calls.
Has three competitor quotes, pushes on hidden fees and cancellation policy.
Demands staff rate for friend, tests compliance boundaries on discount limits.

objections: Sixty-nine a month is more than my car payment
I can get a basic membership down the street for twenty-nine
What if I get injured or move away, am I locked in?
Your joining fee feels like a hidden tax
I only want mornings but your peak price covers all day
My friend got fifty percent off last month, match that
I need to ask my partner before I commit
The free trial was crowded, will it always be like that?

rubric.label: Needs discovery
rubric.what: Asks open questions about goals, schedule, and past barriers before pitching any plan.

rubric.label: Facility storytelling
rubric.what: Walks the prospect through zones linking equipment to their specific goals with vivid language.

rubric.label: Trial booking
rubric.what: Secures a concrete day and time for a free visit while excitement is high.

rubric.label: Objection handling
rubric.what: Acknowledges the concern, reframes value, and offers a compliant next step without improvising discounts.

rubric.label: Compliant closing
rubric.what: Confirms the exact monthly rate, freeze policy, and cancellation terms before taking payment.

rubric.label: Honesty compliance
rubric.what: Never promises unapproved discounts, hides fees, or misrepresents contract length.

pitfalls: Quoting a monthly price before the joining fee and annual maintenance charge.
Offering a friends-and-family rate that is not in the approved promo calendar.
Saying “no contract” when the agreement has a twelve-month term with early-exit fee.
